integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. The bundled numerical checker is only a finite sanity test and is not evidence for the infinite-dimensional quantifiers.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for real spaces, infinite index sets, finite test families, and \(2\le p<\infty\).
No claim is made for \(1\le p<2\), complex scalars, finite-dimensional spaces, or larger transfinite test families.
